source_note: Chinese hot-topic candidates are collected from public trend pages; English wording is matched to supplied official English headlines when possible, otherwise suggested neutrally.

topics.chinese_topic: 构建更高水平的全民健身公共服务体系
topics.official_english: Building a Higher-Level Public Service System for National Fitness
topics.why_hot: National fitness policies directly affect public health and access to sports facilities, making the topic relevant to a wide audience.
topics.share_angle: Use plain language to explain what a higher-level public service system means for everyday people, from community facilities to health campaigns.

topics.chinese_topic: 台风白海豚在浙江玉环沿海登陆
topics.official_english: Typhoon Dolphin Makes Landfall on Coast of Yuhuan, Zhejiang
topics.why_hot: A typhoon landfall in a populous coastal province is a major event that triggers safety alerts and affects millions of people.
topics.share_angle: Explain the basics of typhoon landfalls, why people evacuate, and what local authorities typically do to protect residents.

topics.chinese_topic: 香港刷新1884年以来最高气温纪录
topics.official_english: Hong Kong Records Highest Temperature Since 1884
topics.why_hot: Breaking a roughly 140-year temperature record makes extreme heat a concrete climate issue for one of Asia's most crowded cities.
topics.share_angle: Turn the record into a clear lesson about urban heat, climate change and personal heat-safety tips.

topics.chinese_topic: 如何看待当前物价运行态势
topics.official_english: Assessing the Current Price Trends in China
topics.why_hot: Price movements are tied to daily living costs, so discussions about the current price situation draw immediate attention from households.
topics.share_angle: Break down why price changes matter for households and what terms like overall price level mean in official statements.

topics.official_english: Back-to-School 'Three Essentials' See Sharp Price Increases
topics.why_hot: As the new term approaches, the rising cost of school supplies is a relatable pocketbook issue for parents across China.
topics.share_angle: Discuss the seasonal demand behind back-to-school price rises and what families can do to avoid overspending.

topics.chinese_topic: 浙江省甬江发生2026年第1号洪水
topics.official_english: No. 1 Flood of 2026 Hits Yong River in Zhejiang
topics.why_hot: The first numbered flood of the year on a major Zhejiang river highlights the severity of recent storm rainfall and the need for flood control.
topics.share_angle: Explain how rivers are classified into numbered floods and why this matters for disaster preparedness.

topics.chinese_topic: 原字节跳动机器人一号位加入小米
topics.official_english: Former Head of ByteDance Robotics Joins Xiaomi
topics.why_hot: Senior talent moves between major Chinese tech companies are closely watched as signals of strategic direction in robotics and smart hardware.
topics.share_angle: Frame the move as a window into China's robotics race and why consumer tech giants are investing in advanced automation.

topics.chinese_topic: 南航回应深圳飞无锡航班起飞时遭雷击
topics.official_english: China Southern Responds to Report of Lightning Striking Shenzhen-Wuxi Flight During Takeoff
topics.why_hot: Any incident involving a passenger plane sounds alarming; the airline's response matters for public trust in aviation safety.
topics.share_angle: Explain why lightning reports involving aircraft are investigated seriously and what passengers should know about flight safety protocols.
